note: APPROXIMATE. Grand Central's main concourse is publicly reported at roughly 275ft x 120ft (83.8m x 36.6m). This camera's reference.jpg (1920x1080) covers a sub-region of that floor - not the whole concourse - so the four points below are the visible floor's back wall and near edge, assigned a hand-estimated real-world span (34m across the back wall, 45m of depth toward the camera) derived from that public figure and the image's own perspective. This is NOT a surveyed calibration; it stands in for what a user would normally supply by clicking 4 points and entering one measured distance on site. The calibration module itself (proxemix/calibration.py) is exact given exact inputs - only these specific numbers are approximate.
